jena: Heads-up on Zirconia13B onboarding: int4 run shows an odd degradation only on long-form QA. short prompts OK, but answers go off-distribution after ~1.5k tokens. anyone seen a similar pattern with headpacking?
omar: not with Zirconia specifically, but that symptom often points at kvcache offset shifts or per-head rotary inconsistencies. can you paste the quant flags?
jena: used `redwood-quantize --model zirconia13b --dtype int4 --group 32 --calib 2048 --preserve-fp16-embeddings=false`
jena: calibration stats looked reasonable (ppl delta 0.03) but our long QA eval RougeL dropped 0.12.
vinh: did you check tokenizer idempotence? last time a stray sentinel / pad behavior shifted indices and produced exactly this after ~1k tokens.
jena: good point. upstream tokenizer has `pad_token=0` but marks a ZERO WIDTH JOINER in merges as a ligature that should NOT be split. our shim accidentally treats that ligature as two tokens and emits a SENTINEL=50256 at boundaries.
omar: that sentinel insertion will shift kvcache reads for affected streams. also check model metadata: I've seen exporters infer head packing when both `num_attention_heads` and `num_key_value_heads` are present. if the conversion picks the wrong one, rotary math gets mixed up.
vinh: ran `inspect-rotary zirconia13b --raw` on both fp16 and int4 artifacts. fp16 rotary angles per head are smooth; int4 artifact shows alternating sign flips on every 4th head and a ~0.5 scale on a contiguous block. dump: `rotary_angles: 1.0,0.98,-0.49,-0.51,0.99,0.97,-0.50,-0.52,...`
jena: that explains why cosines between quant embed projections and fp16 drift after a while — headwise rotations are inconsistent.
omar: likely cause: the int4 packing routine reorders heads for simd tiling (pack size 4) but the exporter forgot to permute the rotary/scales array in the same way. conversion bug.
vinh: workaround: re-quant with `--preserve-layout` and `--no-head-reorder`. small perf hit but sanity check.
jen a: (typo) re-ran with preserve-layout and updated tokenizer loader to respect `normalize_form: \"NFKD\"` from upstream. quick smoke:
```
zirconia fp16: p95 82ms, longQA-rougeL 0.57
zirconia int4.reconv: p95 63ms, longQA-rougeL 0.55
```
jena: is close. toggling preserve-layout recovered most of the quality.
omar: follow-up actions: 1) exporter change - when reordering heads for kernel packs, apply same permutation to rotary/scales metadata and to any per-head attention params. 2) tokenizer loader - add explicit normalization semantics test (NFKD vs NFKC) and add roundtrip on our canonical prefixes. 3) add unit that diffs kvcache row indices for a small prefix sequence between upstream tokenizer and our shim.
vinh: i've prototyped a small diagnostic `kv-offset-check` that runs a short prompt and compares the kvcache key hashes per token between fp16 and quant artifacts; adding to onboarding suite.
jen a: haha fixing the name: jena.
ci-bot: CI: zirconia13b-int4-preserve-layout smoke passed (short-eval), long-eval queued.
jen a: will open PR to exporter with a failing test that asserts `len(rotary_scales) == num_attention_heads` and that any reordering is applied consistently. PR draft #1102.
omar: also add a post-conversion assertion that tokenizer roundtrip on 50 canonical prefixes returns identical ids to upstream.
jen a: scheduling: if long-eval passes, plan to canary to Dedicated pool. ops-bot: can you schedule?
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: zirconia13b-int4-reconv -> dedicated-canary-5 at 2026-03-22T03:15:00Z.
jen a: TL;DR: root cause was two compounding issues - tokenizer ligature normalization / sentinel insertion + exporter head-reorder not applying to rotary metadata. Fixes: update tokenizer loader, prefer explicit metadata reordering in exporter, add kv-offset-check to onboarding. tagging @vinh @omar for followups.
